testCases.input: We need basic task metadata (title, status, assignee) with Notion-style content blocks and a list of time entries with user, duration in minutes, and date.
We need a task model where time can either be logged manually as a fixed duration or tracked live with an ongoing timer, alongside hierarchical Notion-style nested subtasks.
We need a lightweight task record that treats work sessions as time intervals (start time and end time) rather than total minutes, with dynamic custom property fields.
